name: Open Anatomy Browser (OABrowser)
what_it_is: A browser-based 3D viewer for anatomy atlases that renders meshes and volumetric data from a structured atlas JSON descriptor; designed to run as a static subdirectory alongside an atlas data repository.
modes: Offline via Service Worker (disabled by default)
constraints: Atlas data must be served over HTTP/HTTPS; no file:// access
Firebase SDK v3 pinned with hard-coded project credentials
